The listed bicycle parking regulations do not apply to prevent the erection or use of a lawfully existing building or structure.
calculation_handling.gaps: Whether a building is lawfully existing is an as-built fact we do not hold.

calculation_handling.description: For 230.90.1(3), lawful also includes existing or authorized after July 22, 2022 and on or prior to March 31, 2025.

230.90.1(1).explanation: A lawfully existing building or structure is not blocked from being built or used by a list of bicycle parking rules in Chapters 10, 15, 30, 40, 50, 60, 80 and 230, including the bicycle parking rates table. Lawful here includes anything existing or authorized on or before July 22, 2022 (see 230.90.1(2)).

230.90.1(2).explanation: For 230.90.1(1), lawful includes buildings or uses that existed or were authorized on or before July 22, 2022.

230.90.1(3).explanation: A narrower list of bicycle parking rules, including the rates table, also does not prevent the erection or use of a lawfully existing building or structure. Lawful here covers things existing or authorized after July 22, 2022 and on or before March 31, 2025 (see 230.90.1(4)).

230.90.1(4).explanation: For 230.90.1(3), lawful includes buildings or uses that existed or were authorized after July 22, 2022 and on or before March 31, 2025.
